name: View Audit Logs
description: Access and review system audit logs for security and compliance

steps.title: Access Audit Section
steps.description: Navigate to the Administration menu and select Audit Logs.

steps.title: Set Date Range
steps.description: Select the start and end dates for the logs you want to view.

steps.title: Filter by User
steps.description: Optionally filter logs by specific user or user group.

steps.title: Filter by Action Type
steps.description: Select specific action types to narrow down the results.

steps.title: View Log Details
steps.description: Click on any log entry to see detailed information about that event.

steps.title: Export Logs
steps.description: Download the filtered logs for external analysis or archiving.
